GlobalCare is the Kayak for medical tourism — but it goes far beyond finding a hospital. It uses AI to analyze medical reports, compare treatment options, hospitals, and costs across countries, connect patients with doctors for second opinions, and plan flights and stays. Once a treatment is chosen, patients can pay in USDC through on-chain escrow on Arc, with funds released according to treatment milestones instead of blindly sending thousands of dollars upfront.

The entire experience is designed around one continuous patient journey. From the moment a patient uploads a report to the moment they have a treatment plan and travel itinerary, GlobalCare brings the medical, financial, and logistical pieces together in one place. AI handles the complexity, doctors handle the medicine, Arc handles the trust, and the patient stays in control.

how_its_made:
built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase, Gemini, Privy, Arc, viem, Mapbox, SerpAPI, and Calendly. Gemini powers the medical-travel AI and report analysis, while Supabase handles journeys, consultations, medical documents, and persistent chat state. Privy provides the embedded patient wallet and a familiar login-to-payment experience.

The key technical piece is a custom Arc escrow smart contract using USDC. When a patient pays, funds move from their Privy wallet into escrow and are released through programmable 20/60/20 treatment milestones, with trustee-controlled release/refund logic and on-chain verification. Live flight and hotel data comes through SerpAPI, Mapbox handles location experiences, and Calendly connects patients to real doctors. The result is a full-stack application where AI, real-world healthcare workflows, travel infrastructure, and programmable money work as one system.
auto_summary: A Next.js application for medical tourism that combines AI-assisted care planning with USDC escrow payments on Arc.
